ops.name: Rough bottom face mill, knock pin hole drilling
ops.summary: Bottom face, cap faces, 2 knock pin holes
ops.note: First operation on the raw casting. Rough-mills the bottom face (pan rail and webs) and the bearing cap joint faces, then drills Ø15.5 and reams Ø16 the two knock pin holes, 417 ±0.025 apart and 126 ±0.2 from the crank centre. These two holes are the locating datum for every later operation. The end face is not cut here, and the production number punch mark on the side face is not shown.

ops.name: Right face mill
ops.note: Mills the right side of the block: the oil filter face and its bosses, and the upper right face pads.

ops.name: Top face mill, rough bore, chamfer bore
ops.note: Mills the top (deck) face to 248.6 ±0.1 from datum Z, rough-bores the four cylinders to Ø94.3 ±0.2 down to the 170.3 mm cutting range, then chamfers each bore mouth to Ø97.2 at 20°.

ops.name: Front-rear face mill, left lower face mill
ops.note: Mills the front face (100) and rear face (200) to 479.6 overall, then spot-faces 11 bosses on the lower left face at three levels (sheet groups 3, 7 and 12). Items crossed out on the sheet (553, 554, 556, 557, 558, 559, 583) are not cut here.

ops.name: Half crank boring
ops.note: Line-bores the half crank only: the five main bearing half bores ① to ⑤ to Ø63 at 128 ±0.2 from datum, and the rear oil seal half bore (190) to Ø117 / Ø118. On the left face it also machines pads 557 and 503, bosses 555, 553, 554, 558 and 559, spot face 517 (Ø26), and drills hole 514 (Ø11.2 × 12 deep with a 90° chamfer to Ø15.2). The bearing cap joint faces and the oil pan rail are not cut here.

ops.name: Finish milling bottom face
ops.note: Finish-mills the bottom face (oil pan rail and the webs joining it) to 248.3 ±0.1 from the top face Z, with 0.05 flatness and 0.1/100 parallelism. The bearing cap joint faces, already machined in CYB-80M, are not touched here.

features.name: Bottom face (pan rail)
features.pos: 248.3 ±0.1 from top face Z, flatness 0.05, parallel 0.1/100 to Z

ops.name: Thrust milling, stage 1
ops.note: Gang-mills the side (thrust) faces of the main bearing bulkheads with Ø150 and Ø160 disc cutters centred on the crank axis, at X 0, 74, 100, 178, 208, 286, 312, 394 and 420. Each disc sweeps the bulkhead face out to its own radius (75 or 80 mm from the crank centre). On the raw casting the front-facing sides are already close to size, and the rear-facing sides carry about 7 mm of stock.

ops.name: Thrust milling, stage 2
ops.note: Finish-mills both thrust faces of the centre bulkhead ③ (the thrust bearing), taking 2 mm off each side to a width of 26 −0.021, located 180 ±0.05 from the datum hole. The Ø87.1 cutter is centred on the crank axis, so the finished face is a circle 43.55 in radius around the crank centre, inside the area roughed in stage 1.

ops.name: Bore chamfering, crank notching, bearing cap seat face finish milling and broaching
ops.summary: 4 bore chamfers, 5 notches, 5 cap seats milled, 5 cap seats broached
ops.note: Working up from the bottom face, in four parts. Bore chamfering: the lower edge of each cylinder bore (456 to 459) at 45° out to Ø96 +1/−0.5. Crank notching: the bearing shell locating notch in each of the five main bearing half bores, 4.7 +0.1 wide and 1.7 deep, with a Ø57.5 cutter. Bearing cap seat face finish milling: the cap seat faces on bulkheads ① to ⑤, to a 3 ±0.05 step and 131.6 ±0.05 width. Bearing cap seat face finish broaching: the same seats broached along the crank axis to the final 132 +0.026/−0.020 register width, finishing the seat face and both side walls with a 45° lead-in chamfer. Chamfer rings, notches and the broached side walls are drawn as finished shapes on the casting.

ops.name: Top face drilling and counterboring
ops.summary: 18 holes Ø9.5 with counterbores, plus 19 more holes
ops.note: Three steps on the top face. First it drills the 18 holes 351 to 368, each Ø9.5 and 34.8 deep. Then it counterbores them: sixteen to Ø11.5 × 10.3 deep, and holes 355 and 359 to Ø13.5 × 6.8 +0.5 deep with a 90° chamfer to Ø15. Then it drills 19 more holes: 370 and 371 at Ø11, 373 and 374 at Ø10, 375 to 382 at Ø7 and 393 to 398 at Ø6, all 13.3 deep, and hole 383 at Ø8 × 70 deep. Positions are measured from the knock pin datum.

ops.name: Bottom face drilling
ops.summary: 10 cap bolt holes, 2 small holes, 7 more holes and spot faces
ops.note: Drills from the bottom face. Ten main bearing cap bolt holes 424 to 433, Ø12.5 × 33 deep, two per bulkhead at X −21, 87, 193, 299 and 407, 49 either side of the crank centre. Holes 448 and 449, Ø6.8 × 14 deep with a 90° chamfer to Ø8.5. Then four Ø28 spot faces 467 to 470 at 90 above the bottom face (X 55, 119, 267, 331); hole 447, Ø14.5 × 24 deep with a 90° chamfer to Ø16.5 (X 193); oil hole 439, Ø8.2 × 39 drilled up from the ① main bearing half bore (X −19); and hole 423, Ø19 × 28 deep (X 394).

features.name: Oil hole 439
features.kind: Drill Ø8.2 ↓39, from bearing ① half bore

ops.name: Bottom face drilling, stage 2
ops.summary: 19 pan bolt holes, 6 oil jet holes, cap bolt chamfers, 2 Ø28 bores, holes extended
ops.note: Drills from the bottom side. Nineteen oil pan bolt holes 403–410 and 412–422, Ø6.6 × 17 with a 90° chamfer to Ø8.5. Oil jet holes 443–446 (Ø5 × 15, chamfer Ø6.5) and 461–464 (Ø3.7 × 8, chamfer Ø4.5) in the Ø28 spot faces at 90. Hole 447 continued at Ø6 to 56, oil hole 439 at Ø8 to 67 ±0.5, and hole 423 continued at Ø15 to 45 total with a 90° chamfer to Ø16.6. 90° chamfers to Ø14.5 on all ten cap bolt holes 424–433. Holes 451 and 452, Ø6.8 × 15 with a 90° chamfer to Ø8.5. Some hole positions are read from a hard-to-read sheet and are estimates. Bores 495 and 496 are machined from the cast holes to Ø28 × 35, at X 266.5 and 329.6, Y 203, opening the cast holes that run from about 85 to 120 above the bottom face.

ops.name: Main oil gallery and front hole drilling
ops.summary: Oil gallery from both ends, 1 front hole
ops.note: Drills the main oil gallery 210, Ø15.23, along the length of the block from both ends: 234 deep from the front face and 234 deep from the rear, meeting in the middle with 2 overlap. The gallery runs 245 across from the knock pin and 26 above the bottom face. Then drills hole 121 in the front face, Ø13 × 17.3 deep with a 90° chamfer, 108.688 across from the knock pin and 70 up. Turn on See-through to see the gallery inside the block.

ops.name: Boring and drilling, front and rear
ops.summary: 3 bores, 5 drilled holes on front and rear faces
ops.note: Front face: bores 124 to Ø30 +0.55/+0.25 × 20 with R5, and drills 159 and 152 (Ø6.8 × 18.3), 118 (Ø6.8 × 15.3) and 155 (Ø10.8 × 23.3), each with a 90° chamfer. Rear face: bores 211 (Ø37.6) and 212 (Ø35.5), each 20.3 deep with a 60° chamfer, and drills 207 (Ø11.5 × 36.3, 90° chamfer Ø13.1). The bores open up cast holes already in the block. Positions are measured from the knock pin and the bottom face. Nothing is cut on the left face in this operation.

ops.name: Right and left face drilling and boring
ops.summary: 5 right face holes, 5 left face holes, 3 Ø43 bores, 1 spot face
ops.note: Right face: five holes 623, 624, 633, 653 and 657, each Ø8.8 × 22 with a 90° chamfer to Ø10.5, in the bosses spot-faced in CYB-20M. Left face: four holes 511, 513, 515 and 518, Ø8.8 × 22 with a 90° chamfer to Ø10.5, in the bosses milled in CYB-60M; hole 517, Ø6.8 × 38, in the Ø26 spot face from CYB-80M; spot face 556, Ø26, at X 193, Z 238; and bores 507, 508 and 509, Ø43 × 38 with a 60° chamfer to Ø47, at X 87, 193 and 299, Z 122.5, opening up the cast holes.

ops.name: Right and left face drilling
ops.summary: 11 right face holes, 6 left face holes
ops.note: ENG-KM-CYB-058 right face drilling and ENG-KM-CYB-177 left face drilling. Right face: 604 (Ø6.8 ↓13.5) at X 205, Z 231; the three bosses 615 and 616 at X 299 and 87, Z 177, and 658 at X 193, Z 185, get a Ø17.5 hole with a Ø35.5 × 14.5 counterbore; 617 to 620 on the oil cooler pad and 607, 654 on the front pads are Ø6.8 ↓18; 621 is Ø10 ↓50 at X 394, Z 45. Left face: 553, 554, 556, 558 and 559, Ø6.8 ↓18 with a 90° chamfer to Ø8.5, in the bosses machined in CYB-80M and CYB-140M-A, and 503, Ø12.5 ↓25 with a 90° chamfer to Ø15, in pad 503.

ops.name: Front and rear face drilling, boring and tapping
ops.summary: 68 steps on front and rear faces
ops.note: Eight process sheets, ENG-KM-CYB-051 to 058. Front face: 18 Ø6.8 ↓18.3 holes, 151 and 157 Ø10.8 ↓23.3, 119 and 120 Ø9 ↓15.3, the camshaft bore 122 to Ø53.2 ↓27.3, and the main gallery 210 reamed Ø16 ↓8.3; then 21 holes tapped M8×1.25 (118 to ↓11.3, the rest ↓13.3, including 152 and 159 drilled in CYB-180M-2) and 151, 155, 157 tapped M12×1.25 ↓16.8. Rear face: 204 to 206 Ø8.8 ↓22.3, 201 to 203 Ø10.5 ↓26.3, 208 Ø10 ↓21.3, 209 Ø9 ↓23.3, camshaft bore 122 to Ø53.2 ↓38 with a Ø55.2 ↓10.4 counterbore and its inner bushing bore Ø52.9 × 25 at 238.8 deep; finish boring of 211 (Ø38 ↓13), 212 (Ø36 ↓11), 207 (Ø12 ↓8.3) and the gallery 210 (Ø16 ↓13.3); then 204 to 206 tapped M10×1.25 ↓17.3 and 201 to 203 tapped M12×1.5 ↓21.3. Positions are from the knock pin and the bottom face. The cycle time and machine are not on the sheet yet.
